# Insert Into Set

![Insert Into Set function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/collection/set/02-insert-set.svg)

[Collection functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Adds an absent element. already included? reports membership before insertion and is true for an existing element; no duplicate is created.
